author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: V. Who abstains.........food: expresses the conditions under which the senses lose their power for acting upon their objects Hence the objects themselves are said to turn away from the person. Rasa in the original means the relish or, longing in the mind for the objects. It does not become extinct even when the external senses are impaired and become powerless for bringing about the experience. But this longing, too, will go when the Supreme Lord is seen ; surely it does, when the Lord is seen.
